title: Coffee Morning
description: Chance for RR parents to meet/catch up, share tips etc.! (Organised by class rep, not a school event.) Upon arrival, ask for Amanda’s tables as they have specific ones for us. If you have a compact/easy fold buggy might be idea to use that one as 6 people bringing pushchairs (cafe is aware of this).  Cafe serves breakfast as well as coffee/cafe: https://wanasacafe.co.uk

title: Return “Xmas4Schools” artwork
description: The Christmas artwork sheet will be going into school to be handed out by the teachers prior to half term break. We are using a new company this year. All is explained on the flier above. (Every year, we organise a Christmas fundraising activity where the children create their own Christmas artwork. We then send their designs to a company that turns them into Christmas cards and other festive gifts, which families can purchase to help raise funds for our school.)
